entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Returns!
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your full name and order number?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF789912.

Thank you, Mark. I have your order pulled up here. You received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th. To best help you, could you clarify the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault! The heart rate monitor is a joke. It says my heart rate is 60 when I'm sprinting. It's completely useless.
I see. That definitely sounds frustrating. I'd be happy to walk you through a couple of quick troubleshooting steps. Sometimes a simple reset can resolve sensor inaccuracies.
No! I'm not doing that. I don't have time for this nonsense. I just want my money back. I want a refund, now. Are you going to process it or do I need to talk to your manager?

I understand your frustration, Mark, and I'm not trying to make this difficult for you. I just need to follow procedure. Let me see what I can do. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I review the return eligibility.
Fine. But if you come back with another excuse, I'm lighting you up on social media.
Thank you for holding, Mark. I've reviewed your order and our return policy. I see here that you've had the device for 21 days.
Yeah, and? The thing doesn't work. I want to return it.

Of course. According to our policy information, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process this return for you immediately. No problem at all.
Oh. Seriously? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. I am emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. The email just came through. Fine.
Excellent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
